fact: The ARPTC, the DRC's post and telecommunications regulator, opened a public consultation on the introduction of 5G in the DRC, announced in a communique dated 18 March 2025 (only the headline is rendered; who took part is not stated).

After a public outcry over interministerial arrete no. 015 of 20 July 2026 setting digital-sector duties, taxes and fees, the DRC digital economy minister held a working session with representatives of the digital ecosystem, including the Reseau des acteurs du numerique (RAN), reported by ACP on 7 August 2026 (meeting on the Thursday before, 6 August).
system: Arrete interministeriel no. 015 du 20 juillet 2026 fixant les droits, taxes et redevances du secteur numerique
